title: Direct Billed Share of a Hotel Folio under a Corporate Programme
content:
The share of the direct billed base carried to the corporate account when the folio of a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range is closed off is read from the credit limit of the active programme in the Corporate Travel Programmes range the reservation is made under.

Where the reservation is made under an active corporate programme whose credit limit is at or above 250000.00 USD, the direct billed share is 100 percent. Where the reservation is made under an active corporate programme whose credit limit is at or above 50000.00 USD but below 250000.00 USD, the direct billed share is 60 percent. In every other case the direct billed share is nil.

| The active corporate programme's credit limit | Direct billed share |
| --- | --- |
| 250000.00 USD or above | 100 percent |
| 50000.00 USD or above but below 250000.00 USD | 60 percent |
| Below 50000.00 USD | Nil |
| No active programme | Nil |

*Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical limits.* A programme whose credit limit is 250000.00 USD gives 100 percent; one of 249999.00 USD gives 60 percent; one of 50000.00 USD gives 60 percent, that figure being the foot of the middle band; one of 49999.00 USD gives nil. A reservation made under no active programme gives nil whatever the guest's own standing.

*Carried through, on a hypothetical base.* Where the direct billed base is 1320.00 USD and the share is 60 percent, the direct billed amount is 792.00 USD, rounded to the cent; at 100 percent it would be 1320.00 USD, and at nil it would be 0.00 USD.
